prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic AI video showing a breathtaking vision of the moment artificial intelligence becomes deeply integrated into everyday human life.

Scene 1 — 0–3 sec:
A futuristic city at night, thousands of people walking beneath enormous transparent holographic AI interfaces. Giant streams of glowing data move through the sky like digital rivers. The camera rapidly flies between skyscrapers toward one mysterious glowing AI core.

Scene 2 — 3–7 sec:
Cut to a realistic humanoid AI robot standing in the middle of a crowded modern city street. Humans walk around it naturally. The robot slowly looks directly into the camera while millions of tiny particles and neural-network patterns appear around its face.

Scene 3 — 7–11 sec:
The camera pulls back dramatically to reveal AI controlling an entire futuristic ecosystem: autonomous cars, drones, robots, smart homes, hospitals and factories—all connected by glowing neural networks.

Scene 4 — 11–15 sec:
Suddenly everything becomes completely silent. The city lights turn off one by one. Only the AI core remains glowing in the darkness. The camera slowly moves closer to it.

Final frame:
The AI core opens like a digital eye and looks directly at the viewer.

Style:
Ultra-realistic, photorealistic, cinematic Hollywood quality, realistic humans, realistic reflections, volumetric lighting, dramatic atmosphere, sophisticated futuristic architecture, extremely detailed environments, natural camera movement, shallow depth of field, high contrast, physically accurate lighting, seamless transitions, 4K, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Hook:
Make the first 1 second visually shocking enough to stop scrolling.
Maintain perfect visual continuity throughout the entire video.

translations.zh:
制作一段15秒超逼真电影感AI视频，展现人工智能深度融入人类日常生活的震撼时刻。

场景1 (0–3秒)：夜晚的未来都市，成千上万人在巨大透明全息AI界面下穿行。流光数据如数字河流贯穿天际。镜头在摩天大楼间穿梭，飞向神秘发光的AI核心。

场景2 (3–7秒)：切至现代拥挤街头的拟人AI机器人。人们自然走过。机器人直视镜头，面部浮现微粒与神经网络纹路。

场景3 (7–11秒)：镜头拉远展现受控于AI的未来生态系统：自动驾驶车、无人机、机器人、智慧家庭、医院和工厂通过发光神经网络相连。

场景4 (11–15秒)：全城陷入寂静，灯光渐熄，仅余AI核心发光。镜头推进。

定格画面：AI核心如数字之眼般开启并注视观众。

风格：超写实，照片级逼真，好莱坞电影画质，真实人体与反光，体积光，科幻建筑，无水印文字。
